mapper.select: SELECT id, task_name, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(task_time, @@session.time_zone, '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as task_time, task_status, host_name, mac_address, create_time, update_time FROM baseline_task ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, task_name, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(task_time, @@session.time_zone, '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as task_time, task_status, host_name, mac_address, create_time, update_time FROM baseline_task WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE baseline_task SET task_name = #{taskName}, task_time = #{taskTime}, task_status = #{taskStatus}, host_name = #{hostName}, mac_address = #{macAddress}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
